title: ESP32-C6 ChaCha20-Poly1305 open-path placement check, #275 against #280, pass 2
board: ESP32-C6 rev v0.2, 4 MB flash, USB-Serial/JTAG; the board whose MAC ends 2C:48

toolchain.rustc: rustc 1.98.1 (nixpkgs), riscv32imac-unknown-none-elf, opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1

harness: WS-BENCH firmware for the C6 (private harness, not published here): ChaCha20-Poly1305 seal/open and Ed25519 for rind and RustCrypto/dalek. A row is the firmware's median of `iters` timed samples (32, or 8 for Ed25519).
note: Control of an interleaved A/B on one ESP32-C6. Each run is one flash of the control image; the run's value is the median over that boot's complete rounds. Every flash of every image is in ab.json.

t275.what: fork #275 head at the time of the build (26-bit Poly1305 and word-XOR ChaCha20 on 32-bit targets), the earlier C6 tag run's control

t280.what: fork #280 at 5af26036 (after 9e5f0d21, which keeps the 16-bit tag add on Xtensa only): the same instructions as t275 on riscv32, at different addresses

results_intro: Second pass of the ESP32-C6 open-path placement check on the same board (MAC ending 2C:48), 2026-11-23, same images as [pass 1](../5430e8b6c600941da22ba76df8334b6a5ec1ca44-open-placement-2026-11-23/NOTES.md). The tables below are this pass's control image (`t275`); [ab.md](ab.md) has this pass's images, [ab-both-passes.md](ab-both-passes.md) both passes pooled, [RUNS.md](RUNS.md) every control run, [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) the method.
results_ab: [ab.md](ab.md) is this session; [ab-both-passes.md](ab-both-passes.md) pools all 2 sessions, in which every candidate has 2 runs. See [NOTES.md](NOTES.md).

pooled.title: ESP32-C6 open-path placement check, both passes on the board ending 2C:48
pooled.note: All sessions pooled: same board, same images (by sha256), same order. `s1-N` is flash N of [5430e8b6c600941da22ba76df8334b6a5ec1ca44-open-placement-2026-11-23](../5430e8b6c600941da22ba76df8334b6a5ec1ca44-open-placement-2026-11-23/NOTES.md), and `s2-N` flash N of this tree. A flash is still one run.
